content.title: About
content.content: Wine Spritzer is a refreshing non‑alcoholic beverage made by mixing wine juice with carbonated water and sometimes a hint of fruit flavorings. It offers a light fruity taste, moderate sweetness, and pleasant fizz, making it a popular alternative to traditional alcoholic cocktails.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Wine Spritzer originated in Europe in the early 20th century as a lighter alternative to full‑strength wines.
There are many flavor variations: lemon, berry, orange, and even herbal blends.
The drink is often served in tall glasses with ice and a citrus wedge for extra aroma.
Because its alcohol content is usually below 0.5 %, it is considered suitable for driving.
In some countries, wine spritzers are classified as non‑alcoholic if the alcohol level is under 0.5 %.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: The combination of wine juice and sparkling water contains far fewer calories than typical sweet drinks.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Wine juice is rich in polyphenols, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: Improved hydration
items.content: Carbonated water promotes better hydration compared with plain juice.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Gentle fizz can aid faster digestion.

items.title: Reduces overeating risk
items.content: Refreshing taste and moderate sweetness help quench thirst without triggering strong hunger.

items.title: Alcohol content
items.content: Although low, the alcohol level may be a concern for those who completely avoid alcohol; always check the label.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Some versions contain added sugars, increasing the calorie count.

items.title: Carbonation
items.content: People with sensitive stomachs may experience discomfort from fizzy drinks.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Fruit flavorings can contain traces of allergens such as citrus.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the spritzer chilled in a glass with ice and a slice of lemon or lime. It pairs well with light snacks, salads, or seafood. For variety, add fresh berries or mint.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 2–3 days and reseal tightly.
